formattedAddress: 110, Taiwan, Taipei City, Xinyi District, Xinglong Village, Lane 42, Yixian Rd, 17號1樓

displayName.text: HANNA Pasta Café パスタ カフェ

text.text:
Visited in September 2025.
Taiwan 🇹🇼 Taipei.

Spotted from our hotel window, I checked reviews and decided to visit. Hanna is a small pasta restaurant; reservations are needed for dinner.

FOOD:

The menu focuses on pasta and small appetizers. For lunch, I chose their signature mentaiko carbonara. The pasta was perfectly al dente, smooth, and soaked up the sauce well. The sauce was rich, creamy, with a slightly oily texture, balanced beautifully with salt and spices. The bacon was crispy and well-cooked, and the mentaiko added an intriguing, flavorful finish. The battered oyster appetizer was solid—crisp, non-greasy batter paired nicely with a complementary tartar sauce.

SERVICE:

Service was good, though you order at the counter. Waitstaff were friendly and attentive.

VERDICT:

Hanna is an excellent pasta bar, likely experts in noodle dishes—you can’t go wrong choosing one. Book ahead for dinner as it’s small. We had a great time.

text.text:
Came here for lunch at around 2pm and it was crowded but managed to get a seat quickly. It is a chic Japanese restaurant and popular with ladies and couples!

Food was served fast and it was delicious! It was a pleasant surprise. Would love the give the other items a try if I’m in Taipei again.
